title: Sheaf polynomial presentations, kernel ideals and differential tensors
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$, regarded as a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in the chosen universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of sheaves of commutative rings on this site. Write $\operatorname{sets}(B)$ for the underlying sheaf of sets. For a sheaf of sets $E$, define $A[E]$ to be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $U\mapsto A(U)[E(U)]$, the polynomial algebra [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] with one variable $[e]$ for each $e\in E(U)$. Restriction sends coefficients to their restrictions and $[e]$ to $[e|_V]$. The coefficient maps induce $A\to A[E]$. A map $\alpha:E\to\operatorname{sets}(B)$ induces evaluation $A[E]\to B$ by the coefficient map $f$ and $[e]\mapsto\alpha(e)$. A polynomial presentation of $f$ is a pair $(E,\alpha)$ for which this evaluation is locally surjective. The canonical presentation has $E=\operatorname{sets}(B)$ and $\alpha=\mathrm{id}$; its evaluation is locally surjective since $b$ is the evaluation of $[b]$. For a presentation $P$, define the ideal subsheaf $I_P=\ker(A[E]\to B)$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-ideal], with section ideals the sectionwise evaluation kernels. A section $p$ of $A[E]$ is locally in the kernel square if there is a covering sieve on which every restriction of $p$ belongs to the square of the corresponding sectionwise kernel ideal. Define $F_P=B\otimes_{A[E]}\Omega_{A[E]/A}$ using sheaf tensor and change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] in module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with the sheafified relative differentials and universal derivation [def-sfb-sheaf-differentials]. For local sections $b$ of $B$ and $p$ of $A[E]$, define $\operatorname{tensorD}_P(b,p)$ to be the image of $b\otimes\mathrm dp$ under the module-sheafification unit.
